exact_non_repeat_scope: 12 combination configs testing XS selector + HTF gate
notes: Key finding: XS selector alone is the most effective mechanism. HTF gate adds too much computational overhead when combined with XS selector on 7-symbol base (both maintain per-symbol rolling windows). All HTF+XS configs timed out at 15min. XS-only configs run in 3-4min and produce strong results. The combination is architecturally infeasible without optimizing the HTF regime memory usage. Recommendation for Round 15: optimize HTF regime to use O(1) memory per symbol (current uses O(n) for rolling closes cache).

exact_non_repeat_scope: 10 dual-state ablation configs on XS-REV ICP+TRX, full 5-segment + budget ladder
notes: P4 dual-state ladder ablation COMPLETE. SO scale 0.75 gives best DD (13.83%, down from 14.44%). Key insight: in martingale DCA, reducing SO scale too aggressively (0.25/0.5) INCREASES DD because positions stay open longer and accumulate more unrealized loss before TP. The sweet spot is mild reduction (0.75). DD 10% gate is not reachable - 13.83% appears to be the hard floor for this strategy. All configs maintain 5/5 positive segments.
